**NPU03624** is a specific laboratory code used within the Danish healthcare system to measure [[thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh|thyreoideastimulerende hormon (TSH)]] [^src1]. It is formally recognized as one of the valid codes that count as a performed TSH measurement for the purposes of clinical quality indicator 3 [^src1]. 

This code is detailed in the technical guidelines for "Atrieflimren i Danmark" (Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark), a national quality initiative managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. The RKKP relies on standardized codes like NPU03624 to accurately calculate numerators, denominators, and exclusion criteria for clinical quality indicators, ensuring that evidence-based diagnostic standards are properly tracked across national health registries for patients being evaluated for atrial fibrillation [^src1].
